response.justification: Bogdan presents a highly relevant background with extensive experience in geospatial data platforms and systems-level programming. His work on GISCollective and Green Map demonstrates direct domain expertise, complemented by strong skills in C++ and Dlang for low-latency, high-performance distributed systems. While not explicitly building a routing engine, his foundational knowledge and technical depth make him an excellent candidate for this role.
strengths: Extensive experience in geospatial data processing and GIS platforms (GISCollective, Green Map).
Strong systems programming background with C++ and Dlang, focusing on low-latency and distributed systems.
Demonstrated senior-level experience across diverse technologies and full-stack development, showing adaptability.
concerns: Lack of explicit experience building a dedicated "routing engine" or "routing tiling" solution specifically.
Primary systems language experience in recent roles leans towards Dlang, not C++ or Rust, though C++ experience is present.
Recent employment history shows a shift towards TypeScript/Node.js, potentially less direct hands-on with low-level systems programming in the last few years.
